research_question: Does the neural teacher require a multi-dimensional pricing span rather than a single characteristic-sorted factor?
validation_selection_rule: Using 2000-2009 only, require held-out-industry HJ and mean absolute alpha no worse than the selected non-neural baseline. Among feasible candidates choose the lowest held-out-industry HJ; if improvements differ by less than one percent choose the smaller factor count.
development_promotion_rule: On 2010-2019, require at least five-percent improvements in both ridge HJ and mean absolute alpha on combined assets and held-out industries, with factor-span Sharpe no lower than the selected baseline.
boundary: Only size-value assets enter training. Industries remain held out. Failure stops this fixed multi-factor objective before any five-seed run; passing still requires a five-seed partial gate and later IPCA/model-out double sorts.
